historical_references.context: Ashama ibn Abjar was an Arab military commander who played a significant role in the Battle of the Camels, which took place in 656 AD between the forces of Ali ibn Abi Talib and Aisha, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad. Ashama commanded the Kufan forces loyal to Ali and is said to have led the charge that turned the tide of the battle in Ali's favor.
